verdict.rationale: The only SDK-relevant evidence is the llms.txt probe, which tells users to check the npm registry for the latest version when installing Stripe packages. That implies official packages exist. The Connect docs mention building with the Stripe API, and an official CLI exists, but no official SDKs are named or documented for Connect. missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs and supported languages, SDK coverage of Connect endpoints (accounts, transfers, payouts), SDK code samples, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
